method: Source, existing artifacts and focused logs only; no reviewer build, test, engine or performance execution.
scope: Automatic native disk cache and resident engine/module reuse
private_snapshot_proof: EmitCall still performs To and CopyCaptured in source argument order before later arguments. Only the second callee copy is removed; duplicate actual values retain distinct caller snapshots.

Only private ordinarily called internal specializations with closed non-owning parameters and scalar/void closed results qualify. Dispatch incoming edges, main/public/export/external/intrinsic entries, captures, region requirements, captured/reusable storage, explicit references and byref bindings are excluded. Addressed individual parameters retain their original entry copy.

Caller snapshots remain live through synchronous calls, recursion and host reentry. Callee mutation affects its private value. Local derived slices obey the existing checker lifetime contract; global parameter-slice escape is rejected. Public ABI and packed layouts are unchanged.
The observed Functions comparator removes a small number of copies. Static copy counts are not evidence of hot execution cost.
byte_stencil_proof: Bounded temporary graph: 512 AST visits, one pure helper occurrence, and 512 expanded numeric/predicate validation visits. Exact plain scalar/u8-slice types; no ownership, callbacks, extra stores, unknown operations, index modes or possible prefix mappings.

Contextual plain i64 on a true u8 index is a lossless load/zero-extension in the scalar emitter. Other narrowing/signedness/index-mode conversions remain excluded. Literal dimensions and renamed rules match structurally, without workload-specific names.

Unsigned bytes widen to eight u16 lanes. Admitted positive additions/constants total at most 4080, keeping signed i16 comparisons exact. Selected results are 0..255 before narrowing. Arbitrary input bytes are preserved, without a binary-cell or saturating-sum assumption.

Debug arithmetic always retains scalar emission. All graph loads and modulo nodes, including dead declarations, are checked. Normal helper removal additionally requires the existing frame-free Leaf proof; release arithmetic wraps.

Before vector loads/stores/division: positive dimensions <=u32, valid row, u64 product <=u32, both logical lengths sufficient, widened pointer+span within memory, and actual source/destination prefixes disjoint. Each chunk also proves all horizontal offsets across eight lanes are within the row.

Pure nontrapping expressions over disjoint spans permit eager vector reads. Vertical wrapping retains duplicate neighbours at heights 1/2. Border lanes, overlap, invalid views or failed proof use the original ordered scalar loop, preserving first traps and partial writes.

Checked assignment saves its prior environment value before helper expansion can replace the map; helpers nested in actual arguments are rejected. The original scalar body and cleanup are emitted once. SIMD opcode selections agree with the focused codegen evidence.
runtime_proof: Normal CLI attempts the SDK default disk compilation cache; default-load failure releases the SDK error and falls back uncached. Explicit --cache-config errors remain strict. --no-cache clears the explicit config; precompiled input skips cache. Timing records actual configured cache state.
Cold ordinary/serial benchmark and preparation commands explicitly pass --no-cache, as does the native ABI oracle. RuntimeSession defaults to --no-cache while retaining automatic in-memory reuse.
One fixed Engine per worker; exact Wasm bytes are reread and compared on each request. LRU retains at most eight modules and 64 MiB source bytes. This is not a bound on total JIT memory.

Each request creates fresh Store/instance/State. Reused linker callbacks obtain current Store data. A linker is published only after every import succeeds, so failed linkage cannot poison the next request.

Engine outlives cached modules/linkers. Python locks run/close, preserves binary output, kills/reaps/closes on terminal protocol or I/O failure, and uses a temporary diagnostic file to avoid stderr-pipe backpressure.

Fresh-process wall includes launch; engine phase starts after module file read. Worker startup and first request are separate from resident round trips; each reused request still creates a fresh instance.

lifecycle_harness.coverage: Two examples, six modes, one warmup and three measured samples = 48 observations; no delivered ten-example performance claim.
lifecycle_harness.identity: Actual adjacent host metadata must match selected binary; exact metadata dictionary/SHA and SDK identities are retained. Compiler, workload, artifact and inputs are pinned and checked again after collection.
lifecycle_harness.sampling: Randomized mode rounds; independent empty miss directories, prepared disk cache, explicit cold and AOT preparation, one resident worker per example. All outputs/status/stderr checked; startup, first request and preparation separately recorded.
lifecycle_harness.labels: Chart explicitly labels cold (--no-cache). Disk hit is expected from preparation, not a fabricated SDK hit counter; worker hit comes from the exact-byte module cache.

performance_boundary.status: Pilot evidence only; fresh final cohorts pending.
